scope: This checks the finite character-projector algebra used in Lemma N'. It does not construct the Kummer extension, prove character orthogonality for the supplied square classes, or prove torsion-coordinate algebraicity.
statement: For a finite orthogonal family of integer-valued sign characters, transformed zero-sum relations imply that the character projector isolates a chosen term and |Gamma| times its integer coefficient annihilates the chosen point.
